name: Game_Run
note: master loop: init tables/GENDAT3/GENDAT2/MISC; menu; attempt loop; frame loop; debrief; end game

name: Mission_Setup
note: briefing (if new mission) + PlaneSelect + map/tileset/parallax/HUD + flight tables

name: Mission_ResetState
note: rack loads by weight/hardpoints/stock; load weight; fuel; gun ammo

name: Mission_LoadBriefing
note: data/M<mode> 0x1c2 record; story; jetlogo.pax briefing; Rand(20) fog; F1..F10 save; resupply

name: Story_ShowAsc
note: data/<asc>: picture+x y + text on page 1; WaitKey_Release

name: PlaneSelect_Screen
note: planech.pax 5x4 slots 20/page; limits L1L2; Aerolimits slots; copies MISC.Z stats 62..120

name: PlaneRecord_Load
note: renamed from PilotRecord_Load: reads the aircraft record (0xdc bytes of MISC) incl. code xor 'Mixamatosis is Fun !'

name: WeaponSelect_Screen
note: wepch.pax; called only from Airbase_Update in flight; DONE / NEW PLANE

name: WeaponSelect_DrawCounts
note: loads and weights of both racks (rack1 weight divides by rack0 per-rack: bug)

name: WeaponSelect_DrawInfo
note: renamed from WeaponSelect_DrawLine: description + stock + AVAILABLE/NOT LOADED into info box

name: Mission_Debrief
note: sarcasm/result text over the last frame; bonus x bravery; sets g_EndGameIndex and g_AbortFlag

name: EndGame_Screen
note: gamedone.pax / AeroScores / final score+credits / endgameN.pax + CD track N+7

name: MainMenu
note: CD check once; srand; loads JETS.N WEAPONS.DAT HUDTEXT L1L2 GENDATAD GENDATA; miscon.pax cursor menu

name: Stub_PlaneSelectOnce
note: empty; called once after the first plane selection

name: Stub_FrameA
note: empty stub in the frame loop

name: Stub_FrameB
note: returns 0; guards a dead Sfx+damage branch

name: Stub_FrameC
note: returns arg1; its Rand(9)/Rand(2) arguments are still evaluated every frame

name: Stub_FrameD
note: returns 0; smoke emitter stub (Rand args evaluated)

name: Stub_FrameE
note: empty; dust emitter stub (Rand arg evaluated)

name: Stub_FrameF
note: empty; burning wreck particle stub (Rand args evaluated)

name: Stub_FrameH
note: returns 0; guards dead Rand(9) damage branch

name: Stub_AeroCountdown
note: empty; called when the Aerolimits countdown digit changes

name: Windsock_Update
note: animated runway object (sprites 0x1e2..0x1e5) found at mission start

name: Runway_SetEndTargets
note: sets 0x8ff04/0x903d8/0x901fc/0x9082c/0x905d4 to the far runway end

name: g_MissionActive
note: 1 while a mission is set up; 0 = NEW PLANE / reselect

name: g_MenuDone
note: menu loop exit; 2 = non-campaign game ended

name: g_AeroUsedRacks
note: 8 ints per player; zeroed by MainMenu; read by PlaneSelect slot 4
